=== Heroes: Xal'atath ===
[Updates]
  Trait:
  • Void Volley [D]
    • [Undocumented] Mana cost reduced from 75 to 35.

    • [Undocumented] Maximum amount of concurrent hits increased from 5 to 15.
    • [Undocumented] Now has a visual indicator for the area covered.
  • Void Step [E]
    • [Undocumented] Moved from the W slot to the E slot.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Void Convergence [R2]
    • [Undocumented] Void Minions amount reduced from 4 to 3.
    • Void Portal
      • [Undocumented] Health reduced from 1200 to 1000.
      • [Undocumented] Model scale increased from 1.25 to 1.5.
      • [Undocumented] Unit radius reduced from 4.5 o 0.75.
      • [Undocumented] No longer has Health decay.
      • [Undocumented] Now lasts 12 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Duration effectively reduced from 20 to 12 seconds.
    • Void Minion
      • [Undocumented] Health increased from 250 to 450.
      • [Undocumented] Health decay duration reduced from 30 to 10 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Unit radius increased from 1 to 1.25 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Attack Speed reduced from 1.33 to 0.57 per second.
      • [Undocumented] Basic Attacks no longer always show as critical.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • [Undocumented] Talents reordered to follow conventional ordering.
    • Dark Heart's Protection
      • [Undocumented] Duration increase reduced from 50% to 25%.
  • Level 4
    • [Undocumented] Talents reordered to follow conventional ordering.
  • Level 13
    • [Undocumented] Talents reordered to follow conventional ordering.
    • Pull of the Dark Heart
      • [Undocumented] Moved from Level 16 to Level 13.
    • Dark Heart's Protection
      • [Undocumented] Silence duration increased from 1 to 2 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Maximum amount of concurrent hits increased from 5 to 9.
  • Level 16
    • [Undocumented] Talents reordered to follow conventional ordering.
    • Fractured Reality
      • [Undocumented] Damage increased from 15 to 45.
      • [Undocumented] Floating damage numbers now merge.
    • Relentless Whispers
      • [Undocumented] Moved from Level 13 to Level 16.
  • Level 20
    • Rift Invasion
      • [Undocumented] Void Minions amount reduced from 6 to 4.
    • Unstable Core
      • [Undocumented] Damage increased from 15 to 45.
      • [Undocumented] Now applies a damage over time effect.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The targeting reticle for Xal'atath's Void Volley now shows its minimum cast range.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Xal'atath's Void Volley to not clamp to its minimum cast range.

  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Mana cost for Xal'atath's Void Volley to not reset to the correct value.
